text_en: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi son of Gedaliah son of Amariah son of Hezekiah, in the days of King Josiah son of Amon of Judah.
text_cn: 在阿孟的儿子约史雅为犹大王的时日，上主的话传给希则克雅的玄孙，阿玛黎雅的曾孙，革达里雅的孙子，雇史的儿子索福尼亚。

text_en: I will utterly sweep away everything from the face of the earth, says the Lord .
text_cn: 我必要由地面上扫除一切──上主的断语──

text_en: I will sweep away humans and animals; I will sweep away the birds of the air and the fish of the sea. I will make the wicked stumble. I will cut off humanity from the face of the earth, says the Lord .
text_cn: 我要扫除人和兽，我要扫除天空的鸟和海中的鱼；我必使作恶的人倒毙，并由地面上铲除世人──上主的断语。

text_en: I will stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal and the name of the idolatrous priests;
text_cn: 我要伸手惩罚犹大和耶路撒冷所有的居民，我要由这地方铲除巴耳的记念和僧侣【司祭】的名字，

text_en: those who bow down on the roofs to the host of the heavens; those who bow down and swear to the Lord , but also swear by Milcom;
text_cn: 铲除那在露台上敬拜天象和那敬拜上主而又指米耳公起誓的人，

text_en: those who have turned back from following the Lord , who have not sought the Lord or inquired of him.
text_cn: 铲除那背离上主，不寻觅上主，不求问上主的人。

text_en: Be silent before the Lord God ! For the day of the Lord is at hand; the Lord has prepared a sacrifice, he has consecrated his guests.
text_cn: 在我主上主面前要肃静，因为上主的日子临近了！上主备办了祭宴，祝圣了他邀请的人。

text_en: And on the day of the Lord ’s sacrifice I will punish the officials and the king’s sons and all who dress themselves in foreign attire.
text_cn: 在祭宴日内，我要惩罚公侯和王室，以及一切穿外邦衣服的人。

text_en: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and fraud.
text_cn: 在那一天，我要惩罚一切跳过门槛， 和使自己主人家充满残暴欺诈的人。

text_en: On that day, says the Lord , a cry will be heard from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second Quarter, a loud crash from the hills.
text_cn: 在那一天──上主的断语──必有喊声发自鱼门，必有哀号出自新区，必有利害的崩溃来自山陵。

text_en: The inhabitants of the Mortar wail, for all the traders have perished; all who weigh out silver are cut off.
text_cn: 居于盆地的居民， 你们应哀号！因为一切商人都已被消灭，一切秤量银子的人已被铲除。

text_en: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the people who rest complacently on their dregs, those who say in their hearts, “The Lord will not do good, nor will he do harm. ”
text_cn: 那时，我必提上灯，搜索耶路撒冷，惩罚那躺卧在酒槽上，心下自谓：“上主不赏善，也不罚恶”的人。

text_en: Their wealth shall be plundered, and their houses laid waste. Though they build houses, they shall not inhabit them; though they plant vineyards, they shall not drink wine from them.
text_cn: 他们的财物必遭抢掠；他们的家园必成废墟；他们建造房屋，却不得居住；他们种植葡萄园，却不得酒饮。

text_en: The great day of the Lord is near, near and hastening fast; the sound of the day of the Lord is bitter, the warrior cries aloud there.
text_cn: 上主伟大的日子临近了，临近了，且来的很快。哀哉！上主的日子是苦的，连壮士那时也要哀号。

text_en: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of ruin and devastation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
text_cn: 那天是忿怒的一天，困苦艰难的一天，破坏摧残的一天，昏暗幽冥的一天，乌云阴霾的一天；

text_en: a day of trumpet blast and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the lofty battlements.
text_cn: 是向坚城、碉堡吹号鸣角的一天！

text_en: I will bring such distress upon people that they shall walk like the blind; because they have sinned against the Lord , their blood shall be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.
text_cn: 我要使人苦恼，使他们行路有如瞎子，因为他们得罪了上主；他们的血流出有如尘土，他们的尸体有如粪土。

text_en: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the Lord ’s wrath; in the fire of his passion the whole earth shall be consumed; for a full, a terrible end he will make of all the inhabitants of the earth.
text_cn: 连他们的金银财宝也不能救拔他们！在上主忿恨的日子，整个大地必要为他的妒火所吞灭，因为他要向地上的一切居民，执行彻底而又可怕的毁灭。
